description: SGLang fork serving natlang's LFM3 RL actors (owner decision 2026-10-29: upstream-maintained Liquid LFM3 implementation, sgl-project/sglang PR #46858, for dependability). The PR branch (with the upstream main it contains) plus natlang commits: exact post-temperature sampled-token logprob and top-k returned compactly per token (custom_params.natlang_top_k); LFM3 producer spans (the export's producing embedding table, span state mapped in extend and decode) and the native-state export of a closed span (custom_params.natlang_capture) and native-state import through content-hashed placeholders (custom_params.natlang_import), and per-request native adapters in resident low-rank slots (custom_params.natlang_adapter; batches without an adapted request replay the base-only decode graph). The natlang serving front is serve/sglang_actor.py (scripts/neuralese_data/serve_native_checkpoint.py --engine sglang); the checkpoint is served through export/native_hf.py. NATLANG_FORK.md in the fork documents the base, our commits and the rebase procedure. A separate git checkout, not vendored.
install: uv venv -p 3.12 VENV && uv pip install -p VENV/bin/python -e ../sglang-natlang/python --extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu130 --index-strategy unsafe-best-match
parity: scripts/neuralese_data/check_sglang_lfm3_parity.py (LFM3 logits: chunked prefill and cached decode against the vendored HF reference)
scripts/neuralese_data/check_sglang_producer_parity.py (producer spans and span export against native_step: perturbed adapter, forced and decoded spans, BF16 noise floor)
scripts/neuralese_data/check_sglang_adapter_parity.py (native adapter stacks through resident slots against run_native)

previous_commit.note: Prior fork head: padded CUDA-graph decode rows (state sentinel -1) read and overwrote the last LFM3 conv state slot in the natlang conv decode.

qualification: The explicit FFN-only execution profile and SGLang dispatch have CPU coverage only. Native and SGLang whole-model state, actor/learner replay, held behavior and performance remain unqualified.
bf16_reduction: NATLANG_BF16_REDUCTION defaults to fp32-accumulate; reduced is historical replay only
projection: NATLANG_SGLANG_PROJECTION (serve_native_checkpoint.py --sglang-projection): native = the learner's invariant native_step projection kernel; vendor = one fused vendor BF16 GEMM per projection with fp32 accumulation, an actor law the learner recomputes and corrects with importance weights under the engine-mismatch guard (rl/native_replay.py).
